reason: A web-interface desktop-pet plugin that renders configurable Live2D characters, mirrors agent status, and provides interactive overlay controls with persistent model and persona settings.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中显示可配置的 Live2D 桌宠，镜像智能体状态并提供触摸、跟随和拖动互动。
summaries.en: Displays a configurable Live2D pet in the DSH web interface, mirrors agent states, and supports touch, tracking, and drag interactions.

capabilities: renders an interactive Live2D character overlay in the web interface
mirrors agent states through a host-provided SSE event stream
loads Live2D model files from HTTP(S) URLs or configured local paths
reads and writes plugin settings and custom model/persona JSONC files
provides mouse tracking, touch interactions, dragging, and configurable display settings
